name: The Stormspire
shortDescription: The Stormspire, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Netherstorm Consortium tower where the image of Nexus-Prince Haramad receives the equipment and the triangulation reports. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
